plan.title: Frontier AI Labs & SOTA Agentic Systems Knowledge Ingestion, Durable Sweeper, and Vectorization Mesh
plan.goal: Establish a continuous intake, categorization (Hype vs. Facts vs. Signal), vectorization, and durable execution mesh absorbing top AI labs research (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind) and verified SOTA practitioner systems (IndyDevDan, TypeSafe Jev) to keep our local multi-agent software factory operating at the top 0.01% frontier benchmark.
success_criteria: Curated multi-tier intelligence catalog tracking top lab research, frontier papers, and practitioner systems
Automated Hype vs. Facts vs. Signal classifier filtering incoming intelligence with reproducible receipts
Continuous vectorization pipeline syncing high-signal findings into local AIDB RAG and MemoryBroker (:8003)
Durable autonomous background sweeper executing under aq-confine with checkpoint recovery across system rebuilds
Full compliance with WORKFLOW-CANON, Tier-0 validation gates, and independent review disposition

phases.name: SOTA Research Ingestion & Source Catalog
phases.goal: Curate and ingest research sources across frontier AI labs, arXiv feeds, and verified practitioner engineering blogs

phases.name: Hype vs. Facts vs. Signal Classification Engine
phases.goal: Implement deterministic classification prompt and validator ensuring only verified, high-signal patterns reach active memory

phases.name: Durable Background Sweeper & State Checkpointer
phases.goal: Deploy aq-durable-sweeper under aq-confine with periodic runs and crash-resilient state checkpointing

phases.name: Automated Vectorization & Memory Seeding
phases.goal: Wire high-signal findings into AIDB Qdrant collections and MemoryBroker semantic memory

items.name: Curate and register frontier AI research sources in sources catalog
items.goal: Expand sources.yaml with top labs (DeepMind, Anthropic, OpenAI), arXiv feeds (cs.AI, cs.MA, cs.CL), and verified practitioner channels (IndyDevDan, TypeSafe Jev)
items.validation_goal: aq-frontier sources validates clean 40+ source catalog with proper trust tiers and cadences

acceptance.note: Verified via test-frontier-sources.py (5/5 PASS) and aq-frontier sources (40 sources indexed across 6 pillars)

items.name: Implement Hype vs Facts vs Signal classification contract and runner
items.goal: Author classifier prompt, schema, and Python runner evaluating technical claims, reproducible code, and applicability
items.validation_goal: unit tests verify accurate classification on golden dataset of hype vs fact vs signal examples

acceptance.note: Verified via test-intelligence-classifier.py (all tests pass) and schema/prompt fixtures

items.name: Durable sweeper runner with state checkpointing under aq-confine
items.goal: Implement aq-durable-sweeper CLI with JSON state checkpointing, resumption upon interrupt, and sandboxed execution

acceptance.note: Verified via aq-durable-sweeper (--dry-run, --status, and heuristic unit verification)

items.name: Automated vector sync and institutional memory pipeline
